title: BenchmarkReport
description: One report: Bencher Metric Format v0 (https://bencher.dev/v0/bmf.json, as published on 2026-10-30), restated in draft 2020-12. BMF has no room for a version inside the file, so index.json gives it as the report's `format`, bmf/v0. Keys are case ids, then measure ids, from index.json.
